purpose: Frozen original encoder plus structurally pruned decoder; optimize recursive decoding drift under fixed teacher quantized latents, never an estimated-rate acceptance proxy
source_evidence: Pinned DMC.decode_core and reconstruct_y_hat explicitly expose drift training. Y entropy scale indices depend on raw z_hat and fixed repeat geometry, not learned decoder context; exact entropy tables and actual EOF decoding must still be verified.
training_data: 16 GOT10k official training videos,96 frames each, chosen by fixed SHA256 video order from first2 public training archives
selection_data: 4 disjoint GOT10k official training videos,96 frames each; no MOT17 data or candidate quality used in learning or selection
rankings: Existing v2 Taylor calibration on independent Vimeo calibration split
recovery: 100 sampled96-frame video/rate iterations; truncated BPTT16, Adam3e-5, clip0.5; first25 iterations teacher-reference warmup followed by student-owned recurrence; exact teacher quantized residuals and hyperlatents
loss: 0.9 teacher-output YUV6:1:1 MSE +0.1 original-frame YUV6:1:1 MSE +0.05 teacher-feature MSE; all quantizers, encoder and entropy weights frozen
pretest_selection: Highest decoder convolution MAC reduction satisfying all long GOT selection pairs at VMAF>=95% teacher, exact actual bytes; retain best per scope and original conservative head comparison
acceptance: Independent fresh-process rANS decoding of the same actual baseline files; verify equal entropy tables and unchanged latent geometry, all69 held-out pairs, zero bitrate difference, no tuning after test
